name: icloud-doctor
description: Diagnose and safely repair common iCloud Drive problems on one or more Macs.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose multi-Mac iCloud Drive sync and recovery issues.
interface.longDescription: Explains Finder iCloud status, diagnoses stalled uploads and downloads, multi-Mac conflicts, storage limits, accidental deletion, Desktop and Documents problems, and competing cloud providers, then offers only evidence-matched safe repairs.
defaultPrompt: Use $icloud-doctor workspace-check before working in the current workspace.
Use $icloud-doctor sync-check to diagnose why iCloud Drive is not syncing.
Use $icloud-doctor storage-check to see whether capacity is blocking sync.
Use $icloud-doctor folders-check to inspect Desktop and Documents synchronization.
